Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.
translations.bsb: We command and urge such people by our Lord Jesus Christ to begin working quietly to earn their own living.
translations.kjv: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
translations.asv: Now them that are such we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
